name: Nemesis of the Hopeless Romantic
source:
Andrew is just your typical high school student. Sitting in class with nothing to do, he decides that he needs a girlfriend and sets out to claim one for himself. Of course, with nothing but his love of love, turmoil quickly shows as he realizes love is not loving. Can Andrew surpass the obstacles that are put in his way and finally find true love?
[From:[url=http://games.renpy.org/game/NotHR]Ren'py Arcives[/url]]
translation:
安德鲁只是典型的高中生。坐在课堂上无所事事的他决定自己需要一个女朋友，并开始为自己争取一个女朋友。当然，除了对爱的热爱之外，他一无所有，当他意识到爱不是爱时，混乱很快就会显现出来。安德鲁能否克服重重障碍，最终找到真爱呢？
[来自：[url=http://games.renpy.org/game/NotHR]Ren'py Arcives[/url]]
